notes: Two sections: PROC PRINCOMP with the COV option (eigenvalues/eigenvectors on the covariance matrix) on the Wechsler subtest data, and the 95%-prediction-ellipse PROC IML module (already self-contained in the source -- hardcoded mu/sigma, no external data). All 37 rows of data/wechsler.txt inlined via DATALINES in place of the original INFILE path. Two edits: `pi=2.d0*arsin(1);` (a Fortran-style double-precision literal, not standard SAS numeric syntax) replaced with the documented `pi=constant('PI');`; and a PROC PRINT of the IML-created ellipse dataset added at the end since the source only fed it to PROC GPLOT, which was dropped as graphics-only.
